Hi Jeff,

That's understood, and noted in writing: you want the Magic M. 40T in place of the B30. You're right that this was avoidable. If we'd answered you in October, it would have been a simple swap.

I checked the warehouse again before replying. Your B30 and the Power K. have now left our Chattanooga warehouse on tracking ····. Because it's already shipped, I can't switch the order over from my side. If I did, you'd end up with both units.

Here's what the swap looks like. A Magic M. 40T costs $799, the same as you paid for the B30, so neither of us owes the other anything. It's not in stock today. It's a pre-order that ships by December 21, 2026. The B30 will need to come back to us, and we'll arrange the return as part of the swap.

I've passed your yes to the team, with every detail above, so they can set up the return and the Magic M. order. The team is offline for the weekend. They'll pick this up Monday at 10am ET and email you here with the return details. Until then, please keep the B30 in its box and don't set it up.

Sarah
